task: Build a real navigation shell (sidebar, identity bar, six-view routing) in ui/renderer.js replacing the current three-hard-coded-div toggle, and re-home the existing CLI analytics entry point into it.

key_reasoning.reason: Net-new subsystem: sidebar, identity bar, router/view-registry, footer log stub, update-banner region and analytics re-homing are 4+ distinct components with no existing sidebar/router precedent in the repo — new abstractions, not an extension of one; bumped from L to XL under the 'Refactor large subsystem' red flag since showView's 3-way toggle is being replaced wholesale.

No exact precedent exists (greenfield UI area — five targeted codegraph queries found nothing beyond the 3-way showView toggle), and the code being rewritten (showView, runAnalytics caller wiring) has zero existing test coverage, so the refactor has no regression safety net; smoke-mode (CODEMIE_SMOKE/CODEMIE_PROBE_SMOKE) depends on showView('wizard') and .step-row DOM structure that must survive the rewrite. Rollback is still simple (frontend-only, single commit revert), keeping this at L rather than XL.

Acceptance criteria are concrete and enumerated (six views, sidebar grouping, identity-bar fields, footer/update-banner slots, analytics re-entry), but the identity bar's account/profile/model/project data sources are explicitly flagged as speculative/unconfirmed in the research and left open for spec/plan.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L to XL: 'replacing the current three-hard-coded-div toggle' with a six-view router/sidebar/identity-bar is a wholesale refactor of the navigation subsystem
